spec.description: Business metrics for Expenses sharing app — events, users, expenses

spec.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Events" FROM "${postgres_schema}".event WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt), 1) AS "Avg Expenses/Event"
FROM (
  SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM "${postgres_schema}".expense
  WHERE expense_type = 'expense'
  GROUP BY event_id
) t

spec.description: Average number of expenses added per event
spec.title: Avg Expenses / Event

spec.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
    ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (last_ex - ev.created_at)) / 3600
  )::numeric, 1
) AS "Median Lifetime (h)"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".event ev
JOIN (
  SELECT event_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_ex
  FROM "${postgres_schema}".expense
  GROUP BY event_id
) lx ON lx.event_id = ev.id
WHERE ev.deleted_at IS NULL

spec.description: Median hours from event creation to last expense added
spec.title: Median Event Lifetime

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  c.code AS "Currency",
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS "Events"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".currency c
JOIN "${postgres_schema}".event e ON e.currency_id = c.id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY c.code
ORDER BY "Events" DESC

spec.description: How many events use each base currency
spec.title: Currency Distribution

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', ev.created_at) AS time,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT ex.event_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ev.id), 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS "Activation %"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".event ev
LEFT JOIN "${postgres_schema}".expense ex
  ON ex.event_id = ev.id AND ex.expense_type = 'expense'
WHERE $__timeFilter(ev.created_at) AND ev.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: % of events created that got at least 1 expense (by day)
spec.title: Activation Rate

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_custom_rate = true)  AS "Custom Rate",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_custom_rate = false) AS "Auto Rate"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".expense
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND expense_type = 'expense'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Expenses with manually set exchange rate vs auto rate, per day
spec.title: Custom Rate Usage

spec.rawSql:
WITH expense_stats AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    COUNT(*) AS expenses,
    MIN(created_at)::date AS first_expense,
    MAX(created_at)::date AS last_expense,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_custom_rate = true) AS custom_rates
  FROM "${postgres_schema}".expense
  WHERE expense_type = 'expense'
  GROUP BY event_id
),
user_stats AS (
  SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS users
  FROM "${postgres_schema}".user_info
  GROUP BY event_id
)
SELECT
  ev.name AS "Event Name",
  COALESCE(ex.expenses, 0) AS "Expenses",
  COALESCE(ui.users, 0) AS "Users",
  ex.first_expense AS "First Expense",
  ex.last_expense AS "Last Expense",
  (ex.last_expense - ex.first_expense) AS "Active Days",
  COALESCE(ex.custom_rates, 0) AS "Custom Rates"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".event ev
LEFT JOIN expense_stats ex ON ex.event_id = ev.id
LEFT JOIN user_stats ui ON ui.event_id = ev.id
WHERE ev.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY "Expenses" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

spec.title: Top 20 Most Active Events

spec.description: All user_info records across all events
spec.title: Total Users

spec.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Expenses" FROM "${postgres_schema}".expense WHERE expense_type = 'expense'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_who_paid_id) AS "MAU" FROM "${postgres_schema}".expense WHERE expense_type = 'expense' AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW())

spec.description: Unique payers in expenses this calendar month
spec.title: MAU (current month)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS "New Events"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".event
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
  SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('day', created_at)) AS "Cumulative"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".event
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS "New Users"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".user_info
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
  SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('day', created_at)) AS "Cumulative"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".user_info
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: New user_info records created per day (across all events)
spec.title: Users Over Time

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE expense_type = 'expense') AS "Expenses",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE expense_type = 'refund')  AS "Refunds"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".expense
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Number of expense records created per day
spec.title: Expenses Per Day

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_who_paid_id) AS "DAU"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".expense
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND expense_type = 'expense'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  date_trunc('month', created_at) AS time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_who_paid_id) AS "MAU"
FROM "${postgres_schema}".expense
WHERE expense_type = 'expense'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Unique user_who_paid_id per day in expense records
spec.title: DAU — Active Payers Per Day
